document.adaptation: A clause dropped (“of the report released at the 2006 “World Water Week” conference in Stockholm”).
document.text: "We will have to change business as usual in order to deal with growing scarcity," said Frank Rijsberman, director general of the IWMI. Solutions included helping poor countries to grow more food with available fresh water via simple, low-cost measures, a shift from past policies that favoured expensive dams or canals, the report said.
